methods.common: Arithmetic production-weighted means of matched unit estimates for the same series and harvest year, using the weather rows’ weights for both methods. No aggregate uncertainty interval is estimated. These descriptive means can differ from the fitted country weather estimate.
methods.history: Season-average Niño 3.4 exposure copied from enso_windows, joined on exact series_id and harvest_year. Shading at ±0.5 °C describes warm/cool crop-season exposure; it is not an official ENSO episode classification.
methods.names: 5346 Brazilian names recovered from local IBGE spelling with unambiguous normalized-name matches. Other names preserve source spelling or normalize case and separators.
